identificationModule.officialTitle: Clinical Studies of New Model Haploidentical Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: compare the new haplo-HSCT model with the traditional haplo-HSCT in DFS、OS、RFS、CR and the degree of GVHD.etc.for the r/r B-ALL patients.

conditions: Relapsed and/or Refractory Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
the Haploidentical Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation

primaryOutcomes.measure: disease free survival at six months
primaryOutcomes.description: the disease free survival of the new model haplo-HSCT will be assessed at 6 months.
we will examine the treatment-related acute GVHD at 3 months.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. the r/r B-ALL patients
2. have the healthy allo-HSCT donor
3. voluntary and signed the treatment protocol

Exclusion Criteria:

1. not match the inclusion criteria
2. important organ is dysfunction, such as heart and/or renal dysfunction,liver failure
3. Pregnancy or breast-feeding women
4. has virus infection,such as HIV,hepatitis virus,and can not be cleared with anti-virus treatment
